title.narrative: Fostering Innovation through Research, Science and Technology (FIRST)

description.narrative: The development objective of the Fostering Innovation through Research, Science and Technology (FIRST) Project for Vietnam is to support science, technology and innovation (STI) in Vietnam by designing and piloting of STI policies, enhancing the effectiveness of project-aided research and development (R and D) institutions, and encouraging the development of innovative technology enterprises. The project has three components. The first component is knowledge and policy development. Under this component following activities will be carried out: (i) research on and pilot implementation of policies to attract overseas talented experts; and (ii) strengthening results measurement in STI. The second component is supporting Government Research Institutes (GRI) reform and enterprises innovation. This component will provide approximately fifteen GRI STI grants to selected GRIs in selected priority sectors. It will provide innovation links between enterprises and scientific communities. It will help in establishment of the national core technology laboratory for mechanical manufacturing automation and embedded technology. The third component is project management. This component will help in strengthening the institutional capacity of Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST) in order to implement the project and comply with the fiduciary, monitoring and evaluation, and reporting requirements. It will also help in carrying out of policy research programs on project activities.

The project development objective is to support science, technology and innovation (STI) in Vietnam by designing and piloting of STI policies, enhancing the effectiveness of project-aided research and development (R&D) institutions, and encouraging the development of innovative technology enterprises.

Definition: Policy relevant research reports carried out with FIRST funding support
Evidence: FIRST commissioned/financed the following policy-relevant analytical and research reports -. Analytical report on Innovation survey of enterprises carrie d out by NASATI. MOST issued Circular no. 04/2018/TT-BKHCN dated 15th May, 2018 on regulating S&T sector statistics surveys outside the National Statistics Survey Program, including the innovation survey of enterprises every 3 years. - Provided feedback on S&T statistical indicators system that was issued with Circular no. 03/2018/TT-BKHCN dated May 15th, 2018 of MOST. - Ci rcular no. 15/218/TT-BKHCN dated 15th November, 2018 was issued to regulate statistical reporting regime of science and technology sector under the state management of the MOST. - Framework to monitor and access public GRIs and usage instruction. - Re search, analysis and review of S&T projects management after 30 years of innovation. - Decree No.87/2014/NÐ-CP on attracti ng overseas Vietnamese and foreign talents engaged in S&T activities to participate in S&T activities in Viet Nam.  - Contribute to Draft Decree to amend, supplement some articles of Decree No.40/2014/ND-CP dated on 12th May, 2014 of Government regulating on appreciating individuals engaged in S&T activities and Decree No.87/2014/ND-CP on attracting overseas Vietnamese and foreign talents engaged in S&T activities to participate in S&T activities in Viet Nam.  - Contribute to resea rch restructuring national S&T program of MOST. - FIRST Project Impact Evaluation Study to be completed Dec 2019.
